answer_1.quote: we performed a case study using LLMs to generate multi-perspective summaries (MPSs) of reviewers' comments

answer_3.quote: we also conducted a GPT-4-based evaluation of MPSs and examined the correlation between human and automatic evaluations
methods: structured, detailed instruction with Likert scale assessment

answer_4.quote: 10 human annotators, all researchers in NLP and co-authors of this paper, were involved as volunteers
answer_4.guideline: evaluators were asked to judge the generated MPS based on five different criteria with assertive statements and a five-point agreement scale
